content.json:
# Microsoft Graph API Abuse
Monitor Graph request volume, error patterns, high-volume actors, source addresses, and frequently accessed endpoints. Establish a baseline for each approved integration before alerting.

content.title: Graph request and failure trend
content.query:
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Outcome=iff(toint(ResponseStatusCode) between (200 .. 399), 'Success', 'Failure')
| summarize Requests=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Outcome
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.title: Highest-volume actors
content.query:
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend ActorId=coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId, AppId), ActorType=iff(isnotempty(UserId), 'User', 'Application')
| summarize Requests=count(), Endpoints=dcount(RequestUri), Failures=countif(toint(ResponseStatusCode) >= 400) by ActorId, ActorType, AppId
| top 50 by Requests desc

content.title: API failure codes
content.query:
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where toint(ResponseStatusCode) >= 400
| summarize Requests=count() by ResponseStatusCode
| order by Requests desc

content.title: Most accessed Graph endpoints
content.query:
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests=count(), Actors=dcount(coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId, AppId)), SourceIPs=dcount(IPAddress) by RequestMethod, RequestUri
| top 100 by Requests desc

content.title: Source IP activity
content.query:
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests=count(), Actors=dcount(coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId, AppId)), Endpoints=dcount(RequestUri), Failures=countif(toint(ResponseStatusCode) >= 400) by IPAddress
| top 100 by Requests desc
